escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, midday): the creative team work wall in the Efeonce studio area, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a 3 m wide pin-up wall of pale grey acoustic felt panels 2.5 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. Printed design proofs (A3 and A4, graphic layouts in navy, white, a little orange and one cobalt blue poster, their content abstract and illegible) are pinned to the felt with steel pins in the LEFT and RIGHT thirds; the CENTRE of the felt stays bare and calm. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of one proof pinned larger than the rest, at head height: a strip of cream paper tape across its top with the handwritten file name in black marker, the dark poster below it with its word and sphere, and the magenta rubber stamp «Aprobada.» across it — reproduce Image 2 exactly as real paper, real tape, real marker ink and a real rubber-stamp impression with slightly uneven ink. At the bottom LEFT corner, on top of a black steel flat-file cabinet, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid WHITE desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the cabinet between 4% and 24% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), matte white finish, crisp bevel. LIGHT: hard daylight from the RIGHT rakes across the felt at a low angle so every pin and paper edge casts a small crisp shadow; dust glows in the shaft near the window. TRACES OF WORK: a few spare pins and a black marker left on top of the cabinet. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artwork from Image 2 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and fully legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
